page.layout: One block: a digitiser's cover sheet. The e-rara logo at top right, the title block with the author, place and year, the library and shelf mark, the access link, a rule, the multilingual terms-of-use paragraphs, a second rule and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. No printed page of the book is on the scan.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. Its contents are left out as instructed: the e-rara banner and logo, the Visual Library logo, the persistent link, and the terms-of-use text. The book's own title, as described on the sheet, is "Assertio Lamberti Danaei quod humana Christi natura neque in unione personali, neque per unionem personalem cum Deitate <logos> sit, et evaserit Deus contra postremum Jacobi Smidelini Andreae filii ..." (Genève, 1585; Bibliothèque de Genève, shelf mark La Gr 17/8 (4)). This is catalogue metadata, not printed text on this scan.
